blocks.text: The ex-aide of former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo has claimed that he made deliveries of suitcases and boxes to suspended Senator Jinggoy Estrada, former Senator Bong Revilla, former Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan, and three others.
